name: segment
description: Segment (Twilio) customer data — no first-party MCP server; community server or native Tracking API

requirements: Segment workspace with an access token (workspace settings -> access management)
Trust in the community package publisher before connecting
notes: Segment has NOT shipped a first-party MCP server as of 2026-10. This entry points at a community-built server (mcp-segment, npm, April 2026) — verify its publisher before granting a workspace token.
Hosted alternatives exist (Composio, StackOne, Pipedream, Activepieces) if you prefer a vendor with an audit trail.
The community server cannot trigger warehouse syncs or create audiences — those stay in the Segment UI/CLI.
Teams that want full control can wrap Segment's public Tracking API (POST /v1/track, /v1/identify) directly.

source.note: No official Segment MCP server — see setup notes
